punchline: Cropping out the context is just another way of lying.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: They showed you a 1933 headline. Here’s what was on the rest of the page.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: A frequent post shows a dramatic clipping from London’s Daily Express on March twenty-fourth, nineteen-thirty-three, screaming: 'Judea Declares War on Germany'.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Conspiracy theorists claim this proves Jewish people started World War Two six years early. But look at what happens when you zoom out to the full newspaper page.
scenes.on_screen: THE CLAIM: 'PROOF JEWS STARTED THE WAR'

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: The actual article describes a proposed commercial boycott of German goods by private citizens—protesting Hitler’s newly established regime and state-sponsored violence.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: There was no army. No government. It was sensationalist British headline phrasing for a civilian consumer boycott against Nazi persecution.
scenes.on_screen: NO MILITARY ACTION · SENSATIONALIST BRITISH JOURNALISM

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Cropping out the columns explaining a trade boycott turns historical context into disinformation. Always read the full page.
scenes.on_screen: READ THE FULL PAGE · NEVER TRUST CROPPING

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Cropping out the context is just another way of lying.
scenes.on_screen: CROPPING OUT CONTEXT IS JUST ANOTHER WAY OF LYING
scenes.source: Beyond the Myth · Facts, not scapegoats
